# Fix the listing text before the store does it for you

> Free tool: paste your App Store or Google Play listing text and check it before you submit — character limits, wasted keyword-field characters, repeated words, promotional claims in the name, placeholder text and keyword stuffing. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
